response.overview: Original animated film for children from the series " Paint Me a Fairy Tale... ", created using the technique of direct-to-camera painting. Ole Śpijsłodko is the third film in the series and the first adaptation of this Andersen fairy tale, similar to the earlier films Len (2005) and It's Quite True! (2014). A magical journey into the land of dreams and imagination. It attempts to tame the phenomenon of dreams and the childhood (and not only) fear of night and death. When Hjalmar falls asleep, Ole Śpijsłodko descends from the moon and invites Hjalmar on a journey through dreams. He transforms his room into a forest where Hjalmar's books and notebooks soar like birds. Another time, Ole summons a swallow, which takes Hjalmar on a soaring journey to the clouds, only to fly to the moon at night. One day, Ole meets Hjalmar with his brother, who visits everyone only once...
response.title: Ole Śpijsłodko
